note: Bibles rebuilt from public-domain sources in Bible Strong's canonical-bible format. Each text is transcribed exactly from the source file named here; nothing is edited. Pinned sha256 values are of the downloaded archive; a changed archive fails the build until it is reviewed and re-pinned.

bibles.title: Textus Receptus (Scrivener 1894)

source.edition: SWORD module TR version 3.2 (2023-10-28), KJV versification, New Testament only. The module prints Stephanus 1550 as its base with Scrivener 1894 variants (seg x-variant x-1 / x-2); the Scrivener 1894 readings (x-2) are kept and the 1550 readings (x-1) dropped, e.g. Matt 2:11 ειδον (1894, KJV 'saw') over ευρον (1550).

bibles.licenceStatement: DistributionLicense=Creative Commons: BY-NC-SA 4.0 (CrossWire module configuration). Attribution, non-commercial use, share-alike. TextSource: https://sites.google.com/a/wmail.fi/greeknt/home/greeknt

bibles.sourceText: Textus Receptus: 'base text is Stephens 1550, with variants of Scrivener 1894' (CrossWire TR module About, https://www.crosswire.org/sword/modules/ModInfo.jsp?modName=TR).
